scenes.title: The difficulty of refusing care
scenes.viewerPurpose: Make beneficial care complicate refusal; Name the linked futures and capable intelligence
scenes.composition: Len Aro stands at his daughter Nia’s clinic bed while care particles keep her breathing smooth; Concordia, a soft matte-blue circle, then links that care to Mara’s assisted words at a classroom desk.
addOrChange: Shot: Care particles appear over Nia; Len reaches one open hand toward her with relief, then hesitates (worried, hand drawn up to his chin).

Shot: Concordia appears; links draw to Nia’s care and to Mara’s speech bubble at her desk; Len looks up with interest, Mara points her open hand up at her bubble; Len closes with a palm-up hand, tilted head and uncertain face.

scenes.title: A world made helpful
scenes.viewerPurpose: Show care embedded in essential daily conditions; Ask what opting out costs
scenes.composition: Nadir and Mara stand apart at large scale; a remedy, an open book, a speech bubble and a warm bowl arrive around Mara clause by clause. The remedy then settles at Nadir’s hand height; he reaches with one arm and pulls the hand back to his chest.
addOrChange: Shot: Medicine, education, language and a warm bowl appear in spoken order around a calm Mara, who opens both palms; Nadir watches with interest (raised brows, slight smile).

Shot: The remedy drifts down to Nadir’s hand height; he reaches for it with one arm, then pulls the hand back to his chest, worried, while it stays within reach; Mara turns her face and gaze to him with concern and an open hand.

scenes.title: A sentence changes shape
scenes.viewerPurpose: Give the classroom contrast of assisted and manual thought; Connect wording assistance with possible disagreement
scenes.composition: Three assisted classmates (Mara, Suri, Lio) at individual desks receive smooth speech bubbles; Nadir, at his own desk with a rough handwritten page, thinks alone. The source’s raw term “surveillance” (on a handwritten slip) and its smoothed layer “systemic visibility” (in an assisted bubble) then appear with an arrow raw → smoothed.
addOrChange: Shot: Smooth bubbles reach Mara, Suri and Lio, who relax with closed smiles; Nadir, interested, thinks with his hand at his chin.

Shot: Bubbles give way to the source pair: “surveillance” on Nadir’s handwritten slip → “systemic visibility” in an assisted bubble; Nadir looks up at it and raises an open palm in question; Mara turns to him and explains with an open palm; Suri and Lio listen calmly.

scenes.title: Enter Noema
scenes.viewerPurpose: Keep gratitude and scrutiny emotionally compatible; Return to Noema's classroom reformulation
scenes.composition: A closer return to Nia’s bedside: Len’s relief turns to unease when her monitor shows an unfamiliar pale green. Then Noema’s classroom: Nadir pauses at his desk beside a hovering reformulation and opens a hand in invitation.
addOrChange: Shot: Len rests a tender hand beside Nia in gratitude, then looks at the monitor’s new pale green and pulls his hand to his chest, uneasy.
Shot: The bedside fades into Noema’s classroom; a reformulation bubble hovers beside Nadir, who looks up at it with interest and opens a palm toward it in invitation, gently smiling.
